blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano on Tuesday urged the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) to consider establishing a safe route through Bahrain for Filipinos stranded in Saudi Arabia which was recently rocked by drone and missile strikes. Cayetano said that a humanitarian corridor must be opened to accommodate returning Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) and the seven Filipino workers wounded after several attacks in Saudi Arabia. “I urge the DFA, DMW, and our embassies to work together with urgency and make sure assistance reaches those who need it,” he said in a […]...
